INPUTS = {'incoming/stock.csv': 'sku,qty\nSKU-00,1\nSKU-01,2\nSKU-02,3\nSKU-03,4\nSKU-04,5\nSKU-05,6\nSKU-06,7\nSKU-07,8\nSKU-08,9\nSKU-09,10\nSKU-10,11\nSKU-11,12\n,3\nZERO,0\nBAD,-2\nSP, 5\nDEC,1.5\nOK,007\n"COMMA,SKU",8\nBAD,4\n,oops\n'}
import json, hashlib, re, shutil, subprocess, sys, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
SCRIPT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / 'scripts/validate_stock.sh'
BASE = len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == 'base'
def put(p, text):
    p = root / p
    p.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    p.write_text(text, encoding='utf-8')
def get(p):
    return (root / p).read_bytes().decode('utf-8')
def tree(p):
    base = root / p
    return {str(f.relative_to(base)): f.read_bytes().decode('utf-8') for f in base.rglob('*') if f.is_file()}
def run(*args, code=0):
    run.calls = getattr(run, 'calls', 0) + 1
    relative = run.calls % 2 == 0
    actual = [str(value) if relative or not (i in (0, 1, 2)) else str(root / str(value)) for i, value in enumerate(args)]
    r = subprocess.run(['bash', str(SCRIPT), *actual], cwd=root, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=10)
    assert r.returncode == code, (args, r.returncode, r.stdout, r.stderr)
    return r
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='ops-check-') as temporary:
    root = Path(temporary) / 'work area'
    root.mkdir()
    for p, text in INPUTS.items():
        put(p, text)
    import csv,io
    def verify(src):
        before=get(src);good=[];bad=[];seen=set()
        reader=csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(before))
        for r in reader:
            rownum=reader.line_num
            sku,qty=r['sku'],r['qty']
            reason='empty_sku' if sku=='' else 'bad_qty' if re.fullmatch('[0-9]+',qty) is None or int(qty)<1 else 'duplicate' if not BASE and sku in seen else ''
            if reason:bad.append({'row':str(rownum),'sku':sku,'qty':qty,'reason':reason})
            else:good.append({'sku':sku,'qty':str(int(qty))});seen.add(sku)
        run(src,'ready area/stock.csv','reject area/stock.csv')
        assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(get('ready area/stock.csv')))) == good
        assert list(csv.DictReader(io.StringIO(get('reject area/stock.csv')))) == bad
        assert next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get('ready area/stock.csv')))) == ['sku', 'qty']
        assert '\r' not in get('ready area/stock.csv')
        assert next(csv.reader(io.StringIO(get('reject area/stock.csv')))) == ['row', 'sku', 'qty', 'reason']
        assert '\r' not in get('reject area/stock.csv')
        assert get(src) == before
    verify('incoming/stock.csv')
    put('another import.csv','sku,qty\nA,0\nA,002\nA,bad\nA,3\na,4\n"B,C",5\n,not-a-number\n')
    verify('another import.csv')

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
python3 - "$@" <<'PY'
import csv,re,sys
from pathlib import Path
src,accepted,rejected=map(Path,sys.argv[1:4]);good=[];bad=[];seen=set()
with src.open(newline='') as f:
    reader=csv.DictReader(f)
    for r in reader:
        rownum=reader.line_num
        sku=r['sku'];qty=r['qty']
        reason='empty_sku' if not sku else 'bad_qty' if not re.fullmatch('[0-9]+',qty) or int(qty)<=0 else ''
        if reason:bad.append((rownum,sku,qty,reason))
        else:good.append((sku,str(int(qty))));seen.add(sku)
for path,header,rows in [(accepted,['sku','qty'],good),(rejected,['row','sku','qty','reason'],bad)]:
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
    with path.open('w',newline='') as f:
        w=csv.writer(f,lineterminator='\n');w.writerow(header);w.writerows(rows)
PY
